[[File:Wookiee_ammo_halter.png|thumb|A Wookiee ammo halter]]
A '''harness''' was a type of gear consisting of a set of straps and fittings attached around the torso of an individual. A common type of military harness, called a '''halter''', consisted of a strap around the neck that left the shoulders and back bare. Such halters were frequently equipped with pockets to hold [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]] and ammunition. While the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] wore that type of gear chiefly in times of [[Ground warfare/Legends|war]],<ref name="ROSV">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Calian]]s of [[Shiva IV]] wore little else than ornated harnesses in all circumstances.<ref name="MSW53">[[Star Wars (1977) 53|''Star Wars'' (1977) 53]]</ref> A safety harness was a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] worn by [[Miner/Legends|miners]] from [[Telos IV]] in the period following the [[Mandalorian Wars]], and aided them in setting [[Mine/Legends|mines]].
